description: This course prepares students to address the growing need for reliable, scalable and well-governed data and AI systems in production environments. As organisations move beyond experimentation towards enterprise deployment of machine learning, large language models and agentic AI systems, they require professionals who can operationalise these technologies responsibly and effectively. This course equips students with the concepts and practices needed to manage data pipelines, AI models and intelligent applications across their operational lifecycle. Students will learn how modern DataOps, MLOps, LLMOps and AgentOps practices support automation, monitoring, continuous improvement, reliability and governance in real-world AI-enabled organisations.
prerequisite: if undertaking an Undergraduate Degree then ( must have completed BT3103 at a grade of at least D )
prerequisiteRule: PROGRAM_TYPES IF_IN Undergraduate Degree THEN (COURSES (1) BT3103:D)
title: Data and AI Operations Engineering
